# Aroon

*Bars since the N-bar high and low, as 0 to 100.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Aroon** under **Trend**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `14` |
| Up color | color | `"#FB8C00"` |
| Down color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/aroon.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Aroon", shortTitle: "Aroon", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const length = input.int("Length", 14, { min: 1 });
const up = ta.calc([ta.highestbars(candle.high, length + 1)], (b) => (100 * (b + length)) / length);
const down = ta.calc([ta.lowestbars(candle.low, length + 1)], (b) => (100 * (b + length)) / length);
plot(up, { title: "Aroon Up", color: input.color("Up color", "#FB8C00", { group: "Style" }) });
plot(down, { title: "Aroon Down", color: input.color("Down color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
```
